## Preparation scope

This article documents the changes implemented for the 1982 presidential election. It preserves the exact capitalisation of the labels used in that script. Replacement values and source findings have not been independently verified for this documentation.

## Postal registered-elector rows

Removed rows labelled `No of Registered Electors` when `Electorate` is `Postal District Votes` and `Votes` is missing. Other postal rows remain.

## Walapane and Nuwara-Eliya vote totals

The code assigns 34,120 total polled votes to Walapane in Nuwara-Eliya, replacing the 24,120 figure described in the comments. It assigns 174,817 total polled votes to `Final District Results` for Nuwara-Eliya, replacing the commented figure of 164,817.

Walapane percentages are recalculated as follows:

| Measure | Formula | Percentage |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Total No of Votes Polled | 100 × 34,120 / 38,414 | 88.82 |
| Total No of Valid Votes | 100 × 33,723 / 34,120 | 98.84 |

The latter replaces the 139.81% value described in the comments.

## Teldeniya and Mahanuwara registered electors

The code assigns 31,145 registered electors to Teldeniya, replacing the commented value of 3,145. It assigns 564,767 registered electors to the Mahanuwara district total, replacing 536,767. Teldeniya turnout is recalculated as 100 × 27,279 / 31,145 = 87.59%, replacing the commented 867.38%.

## Remaining missing vote counts

After removing unavailable postal registered-elector rows, all remaining missing values in `Votes` are replaced with zero. The code does not apply a general zero replacement to `Percentage`.

## Checks and documentation limits

The national figures written in the script also require review: listed candidate votes sum to 6,519,705, whereas valid votes are stated as 6,522,153. Stated valid and rejected votes sum to 6,602,653, whereas total polled votes are stated as 6,602,617. These are inconsistencies in the script's written reference figures, not verified discrepancies in the exported data.
